narration: One equation sums up cellular respiration. Here's how to read it.
Glucose plus 6 O2 gives 6 CO2, 6 H2O, and energy.
Cells use it to make ATP. Eukaryotes get roughly 30 to 32 ATP per glucose.
And all 6 CO2 molecules are released along the way, per glucose.
